docs.text: I don’t have a home river but my home lake is Lake Michigan for sure
What's *your* body of water? The Cuyahoga River specifically and Lake Erie more generally.
I owe allegiance to no river because I have lived my whole life in fetid swamps near the Great Lakes.
Making up a guy: someone who calls themselves a "Bi-coastal elitist" when the coasts are the east and west ends of Lake Erie
My favorite river is the Grand River, which flows through Lansing and Grand Rapids into Lake Michigan.

The Grand River is covered in ice along nearly its entire length, from Hillsdale County to Lake Michigan. Ice coverage on the Grand River is among the greatest and thickest seen in recent years, that thick ice could increase the risk of ice jams later in the season.

I lived on a small river once. the West Branch of the Cuyahoga River that flows through Cleveland, Ohio and into Lake Erie. I've wanted to live on a river ever since.... Now I'm going to listen to your song and see what you think about living on the river.

Turns out where I grew up my home river was the Oswego, which is how the Fingerlakes drain into Lake Ontario on the way to The St Lawrence and the sea Now I am on the Schuylkill, from there into the Delaware Put part of my heart will always be with the Susquehanna
I think my home river is probably Lake Michigan; but I lived on the Columbia River for a few years, and that's my favorite regular river.
my "home river" is the Black River, a tributary of Lake Erie sourced from Elyria, OH that cuts through and separates the West and East sides of my hometown of Lorain, OH
